[Act: limitation
 Chapter: First Division · Part IX · Suits Relating to Miscellaneous Matters
 Section: 102::Three years.
]


For property which the plaintiff has conveyed while insane.
Period of limitationThree years.
Time from which period begins to runWhen the plaintiff is restored to sanity and has knowledge of the conveyance.
